subject: Why as.factor can not be used for facet_grid?

messages.author: c21e804e07c5e732
messages.subject: Why as.factor can not be used for facet_grid?
parts:
Hi,

The following code does not work (the commented line works). Could
anybody let me know why as.factor does not work with facet_grid?
Thanks.

tmp=rbind(
data.frame(method='A', x=10, performance=rnorm(100))
, data.frame(method='B', x=10, performance=1+rnorm(100))
, data.frame(method='A', x=20, performance=2+rnorm(100))
, data.frame(method='B', x=20, performance=3+rnorm(100))
, data.frame(method='A', x=30, performance=4+rnorm(100))
, data.frame(method='B', x=30, performance=5+rnorm(100))
)
library(ggplot2)
#qplot(as.factor(method), performance, data=tmp)+facet_grid(~x)
qplot(as.factor(method), performance, data=tmp)+facet_grid(~as.factor(x))


--
Regards,
Peng

messages.author: 891813bfbff9f848
messages.subject: Why as.factor can not be used for facet_grid?
parts:
The problem has nothing to do with as.factor.
For facet_grid you need two dimentions. If you only want rows you do facet_grid(var ~ .) or only columns facet_grid(. ~ var).
Or you could use facet_wrap.

Kind regards,

Willem
